title.zh: U.S. Treasury sanctions another widespread cyber-scam hub, Xinbi Guarantee
title.en: U.S. Treasury sanctions another widespread cyber-scam hub, Xinbi Guarantee

current_state.zh: 美国当局已制裁 Xinbi Guarantee，查封和限制超过5200万美元加密货币，并将 Xinbi 指定为重大跨国犯罪组织，同时制裁了其相关的技术供应商。
current_state.en: U.S. authorities have sanctioned Xinbi Guarantee, seized and restrained over $52 million in crypto, and designated Xinbi as a significant transnational criminal organization while sanctioning related technology providers.

updates.title_zh: U.S. Treasury sanctions another widespread cyber-scam hub, Xinbi Guarantee
updates.title_en: U.S. Treasury sanctions another widespread cyber-scam hub, Xinbi Guarantee
updates.what_changed_zh: The U.S. Treasury sanctioned Xinbi Guarantee, a cyber-scam hub involved in widespread fraud, as part of ongoing efforts to curb illicit crypto activity.
updates.what_changed_en: The U.S. Treasury sanctioned Xinbi Guarantee, a cyber-scam hub involved in widespread fraud, as part of ongoing efforts to curb illicit crypto activity.

updates.title_zh: US sanctions Xinbi scam marketplace, restrains $52M in crypto
updates.title_en: US sanctions Xinbi scam marketplace, restrains $52M in crypto
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国司法部查封了与 Xinbi Guarantee 相关的两个钱包（约1200万美元），并申请限制另外47个钱包，总计涉及超过5200万美元加密货币；OFAC 将 Xinbi 指定为重大跨国犯罪组织，并制裁了 SafeW Technology 和 Anwen Technology。
updates.what_changed_en: The U.S. Justice Department seized two wallets linked to Xinbi Guarantee containing about $12 million and sought restraints on 47 additional wallets, totaling over $52 million in crypto; OFAC designated Xinbi as a significant transnational criminal organization and sanctioned SafeW Technology and Anwen Technology.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国当局已制裁 Xinbi Guarantee，查封和限制超过5200万美元加密货币，并将 Xinbi 指定为重大跨国犯罪组织，同时制裁了其相关的技术供应商。
updates.current_state_en: U.S. authorities have sanctioned Xinbi Guarantee, seized and restrained over $52 million in crypto, and designated Xinbi as a significant transnational criminal organization while sanctioning related technology providers.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The US Justice Department sanctioned the Xinbi Guarantee scam marketplace, seizing two wallets with about $12 million and restraining 47 additional wallets tied to its laundering network, totaling over $52 million in crypto.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The US Justice Department sanctioned the Xinbi Guarantee scam marketplace, seizing two wallets with about $12 million and restraining 47 additional wallets tied to its laundering network, totaling over $52 million in crypto.
